title: Estimate an exponential rate
description: You compute the reciprocal-mean estimate and inspect its likelihood curve.

steps.description: You sample 300 exponential values with rate 1.8. The generator receives the reciprocal rate as its mean parameter.

steps.question: Does lam_hat equal the sample mean or its reciprocal?
steps.answer: It equals 1.0/z.mean(), the reciprocal sample mean. The recorded estimate is 1.799.

steps.description: You compute observed information and request a Wald interval. The recording gives standard error about 0.1038 and interval (1.595,2.002).
You evaluate k*log(lambda)-lambda*z.sum() on a grid of candidate rates. The plot marks the fitted rate and the true rate.
